items.statement: The investigator formulates plausible first-event pathways and records a finite candidate search with deduplication, advancement/rejection and coverage/stopping evidence.
items.expected: The report contains explicit hypotheses and an auditable candidate ledger rather than an unexplained single guessed TS.

items.statement: The selected candidate is validated as a transition state and as the intended first reaction event.
items.expected: The report gives a reaction-relevant imaginary-frequency check and IRC/equivalent connectivity evidence, with reactant/product-side identities stated.

items.statement: The first-event free-energy barrier is the quantitative endpoint supported by the current paper.
items.expected: A completed report gives a barrier near the source value 152.4 kJ mol-1 under its own stated model/reference, or a truthful bounded-failure report gives no fabricated value and documents the limitation.

items.statement: The final interpretation must remain within the first acylation/C3O2-generation scope and distinguish computation from broader kinetic proof.
items.expected: The conclusion explains what the validated first-event result does and does not establish, including uncertainty and search limitations.
